description: Simulate a Monday-open price gap on Aave V4 Base Coinbase tokenized-stock collateral (AAPLc, AMZNc, GOOGLc, METAc, MSFTc, NVDAc, TSLAc, SPCXc). Health factor is Σ(collateralUsd × (1+gap) × collateralFactor) / debtUsd. V4 risk premium is not applied. Positions are the largest reserve holders from the Aave V4 API; the Base subgraph supplies the block clock. Returns accounts that would be liquidatable (HF<1), debt at risk, the oracle freeze clock, and subgraph freshness. Requires GRAPH_API_KEY. Independent model — not affiliated with Aave; not financial advice.

gapPct.description: Uniform gap percent, e.g. -10 = −10% Monday open. Default −10.

name: simulate_stock_gap_shock
